_comment: AdvantageScope robot asset from the Onshape export (00.Main.glb, exported stowed): uv run tools/sim/cad-to-advantagescope.py 00.Main.glb tools/sim/robot-cad.json --out <AdvantageScope assets folder>. CAD frame: z up, robot front (intake) is CAD -y, frame centre at CAD x=y=0, carpet at z=0. Joint axes and origins are in the robot frame (x forward, y left, z up). Components are logged in this order as RealOutputs/Sim/Components (sim/PhysicsWorld.cpp).

components.name: Intake slide
components._comment: Two rack plates (driven out by pinions under them), the hopper on them and the main roller at their ends. Onshape planar mate: 0.309 m of travel; the rack is inclined 12 deg down toward the front. The real hopper was cut down after this CAD: clipped to 0.555 m (just under the trench).
match: 0200_Intake_Assembly.*(0203_Main_Plate_Inside|0204_Main_Plate|0208_Beater_Bar|0209_Main_Roller|0210_32T|0211_Hopper_Front|0213_x60_Spacer|0214_x60_Spacer|0222_Hopper_Side|0223_Hopper_Mounting_Front|0224_Hopper_Mounting_Side|Stub Shaft|16t Aluminum Pulley|60T HTD Belt|Tube Plug|Nut Strip|Kraken X60)

components.name: Hood
components._comment: ShooterPivot: the pivot frame (main shooter roller at the back, two mini rollers at the front) about the main roller axle (team-confirmed). Axis -y: a positive angle raises the front rollers.

components.name: Kicker bar
components._comment: Frame-mounted arms and two 22 in bars, exported deployed. Onshape revolute: 0 (deployed) to 72 deg folded up.
